svg.text: Air-handler node shield: PCB floor plan, component side
UNO R4 WiFi shield, 86.36 x 53.34 mm, 2 layers, 10 px per mm from the bottom-left corner. Plan: docs/air-handler-shield-pcb-plan.md
Generated by docs/air-handler-shield-pcb-layout.gen.py. Body outlines at planned centres; the routed board is the authority.
R · C on the solder side
24 VAC side: entry, rectifier, call inputs
AC optocouplers, 5 kV input to output
5.1 V from the converter to the R4's 5V pin
logic inputs Y2, W2; FLOW optional
dashed grey: the R4 under the shield
Header pins used: 5V (supply in from U1), GND, A0 A1 air, A3 FLOW (optional), SDA SCL to U2, D8 Y2, D9 W2,
D2 only through JP1. Red ticks mark the isolation barriers inside U1, U3 and U4.
LEDs: LED1 green PWR, LED2 blue Y2 and LED3 red W2 on the 24 VAC side.
